Commentary.Commentary: Stokes' spell with the old ball was lethal, getting the ball to reverse sharply while Ali picked vital strikes for his side. The track is spinning and there is uneven bounce. So, England's lead will certainly be more in impact than the actual number. Tamim's fifty was the highlight of the Bangladesh batting but their middle order couldn't convert their starts. Certainly advantage England at this point. The visitors' 2nd innings isn't far away.

Exceptional morning for England as they blew away the last five Bangladeshi wickets with just 27 runs added to the overnight score. They've taken a very handy 45-run lead. What a turnaround for the visitors! Shakib's brainfade off just the second ball of the day set the pattern of things to follow and except for Sabbir playing a few shots, there was nothing much to write home about for the hosts. From 221/4 to 248 all out, Bangladesh would be shattered.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! That's a wrap to the innings. Length ball on off, Rabbi doesn't offer a stroke to it. Tails back in sharply to disturb the timber. Exceptional spell of reverse swing bowling from Stokes and he finishes with a 4-fer. What a comeback from England! BANGLADESH HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 248.
Length ball outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Good length angled in on middle, Rabbi is rapped on the thigh pad.
Drinks break...It's been an England storm this morning. Kamrul Islam Rabbi is the last batsman...

OUT! Stokes once again angles in a length ball on off and gets it to straighten, Sabbir pokes inside the line and edges it behind to first slip. It's dying in front of Cook who goes down low to his right with both hands to catch the ball. He is not sure and the umpires go upstairs. The third umpire has multiple angles to look, the replays don't look conclusive and he goes with the soft signal which was out. Bangladesh trail by 45 runs.
Appeal for a catch. Is it clean? The fielder is not sure. The umpire is also not sure. He refers his partner before going upstairs. Soft signal is out!
Drops it on a fuller length around off, Rahman stays back and pushes it with an angled bat to point.
Great delivery, angling in a length ball on off and nipping away, Sabbir is opened up and ends up pushing and missing inside the line.
Goes down on one knee and sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Tossed up ball on middle, a googly, Taijul goes back to defend but it takes the outside edge and runs wide of first slip for a single.
Islam has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flatter on off, defended off the back foot.
Helps it off his pads to the leg side for a single.

NOT OUT! Flighted ball on middle, spinning away a shade, Sabbir gets forward with his bat and pad together in defense. It seems like pad first and the bowler turns to appeal. But the umpire feels it's bat first and shakes his head. Alastair Cook has a chat with his bowler before taking the DRS. The replays show it's pad first but interestingly the third umpire feels it's bat and doesn't bother to look further. Hmm...that's a debatable call! Bairstow has shock written all over his face.
Appeal for an lbw. Not given and England take the review.
Stokes comes from around the wicket and bowls a length delivery wide outside off, Taijul has an easy leave.
Back of a length delivery outside off, nipping away, Sabbir pushes at it and runs it down off the outside edge to third man for a run.
Length ball on middle, Sabbir gets behind the line and blocks it down towards mid on.
Leg slip moves out.
Angling a full length ball down the leg side, Sabbir fails to flick and this time Bairstow does well to collect it.

Bang on helmet! That's nasty. Stokes dishes out a well-directed bouncer, Sabbir fails to move away from the line of fire and takes a blow on his helmet. Stokes is quickly to check his well being, Sabbir is fine. But still he is taking his time to recover from that blow. Physio comes out as a precautionary measure. Rahman sips in some water and is looking fine to continue now.
A leg slip in place now.

Bonus runs! Full and sliding down the leg side, Sabbir fails to flick it and Bairstow attempts to stop the ball with a dive to his left. Fails to do so and they collect a couple of byes. Jonny seems to have hurt his fingers and is feeling the pain.
Spinning in from around off, Islam tries to defend it off his front foot but it takes the inside edge and drops in front of short leg.
Bowls a googly outside off, spinning away, Taijul fails to defend it from the crease.
Islam has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tossed up ball on middle, stopping a bit onto the batsman, Sabbir goes back and punches it with gentle hands to long on. He runs the first run hard but that's all he will get.
Floated full ball on off, spinning in this time, Taijul goes for the slog over mid-wicket but it comes off the inside portion of the bat and squirts to deep square leg for a single.
Lovely googly around off, curling away, Taijul fails to pick it and ends up missing it completely.
Sharp delivery, short and around leg, Sabbir is early into his attempted pull shot and hence misses. It goes off his thigh pad to square leg.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Straighter in line, Sabbir defends it off his pads to the leg side.
Back of a length ball angling into the batsman, Taijul goes back to make room and tries to cut. But it comes off the upper half of the bat and runs down to third man for a single.
Stokes comes from around the wicket and angles in a full ball outside off, Taijul tries to drive through covers but gets a big fat inside edge on the pads.
Taijul Islam is the new man in. Pressure totally on Bangladesh now. Still another 54 runs adrift.

OUT! Trapped in front! Stokes angles in a length ball around off and it skids through with the angle after landing. Hasan remains inside the crease as he attempts to flick on the leg side but misses. They appeal and the finger goes up. Mehedi has a chat with his partner and then takes the DRS. The replays show that it's hitting leg and Hasan has to go. Not a good outing with the bat for the debutant. Bangladesh trail by 54 runs!
Sabbir Rahman is given out lbw, he has referred it.
Rahman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
A wrong 'un on middle, Mehedi goes back and punches it to mid on for a single.
Gets back to a shortish ball and punches it to covers.
Tossed up ball on middle, Mehedi goes back and offers a straight bat in defense.
Debutant joins debutant! Hero with the ball, Mehedi Hasan comes out to bat now. We have heard he is very handy with the willow as well. Averages 40.30 in FC cricket!

OUT! Rashid removes the nightwatchman! A good bowling change by Cook. A tossed up ball on off, fuller in length and spinning away a touch, Shafiul tries to power it down the ground, playing against the spin but fails to gather enough power behind his shot. It goes aerial and Broad takes a simple catch by moving across to his left from mid on. Bangladesh trail by 55 runs!
Flighted ball and it's very full outside off, Sabbir drills it through covers for a single.
Adil Rashid comes on to bowl. The second new ball is due but Cook doesn't want to take it just yet. Maybe the reverse Stokes is getting is a factor.
Angles in a length ball on middle and leg, Shafiul fails to keep it out and is hit on the pads. They appeal for an lbw but nothing from the umpire. Missing leg, maybe.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman.
Length ball around off, defended watchfully by Shafiul.
Root has taken a couple of steps forward from a normal second slip position.
Beauty by Stokes! Bowls it on a shortish length around off, Shafiul's footwork goes for a toss, neither forward, nor back, pushes at it tamely and misses.
Angles in a full ball on middle, Islam defends it back to the bowler. Full face of the bat, hmm...impressive.
Full and wide outside off, a typical tail-ender attempted blind hoick by Shafiul as he misses.
Rahman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

FOUR! Back to back boundaries! Loopy off spinner on off, Sabbir once again kneels down and sweeps it across the line. This time he uses his wrists well to place it towards the deep backward square boundary. Toying with the fielder in the deep, the last boundary was to his left, Cook moved him a bit squarer this time and it went past his right side to the fence.
FOUR! Nicely swept! A tossed up ball on off, curling in, Sabbir goes down on one knee and sweeps it firmly over square leg for a boundary.
Good shot! Fetches a full ball from outside off and sweeps it with the spin to deep mid-wicket for a single.

NOT OUT! A tossed up ball landing outside off and spinning in, Shafiul gets forward to defend it with his bat and pad together but is hit on the latter first. They appeal but the umpire isn't interested. Bairstow has a chat with his skipper and they go for the DRS. The replays show that the impact is in line but the ball is spinning down and would have clipped the leg stump. Umpire's call.
Appeal for an lbw. The umpire shakes his head and England take a review.
Tossed up ball on off, spinning down, Shafiul fails to put bat on ball and Bairstow collects it well to his left.
Alastair Cook is wearing his protective gear as he gets ready to field at forward short leg. Slight hold up in play as a result of this! Four men around the bat for Shafiul...
Good length ball outside off, holding its line and staying a bit low as well, Sabbir pokes at it and misses.
Play and a miss! Stokes tempts the debutant with an overpitched ball outside off, Sabbir tries to play a booming cover drive but misses. Needs to be patient here!
Lands it full and outside off, shaping in a bit, Sabbir goes back and defends it off the inner half of the bat. Should have been forward there!
On a length and around off, Sabbir plays inside the line from the crease and gets it away off the outside half of the bat. It runs down to third man for a couple of runs.
Full in length and outside off, angling in a bit, Sabbir stays back and defends it to the off side.

FOUR! Controlled edge! Full in length and outside off, Sabbir pushes inside the line with a soft bottom hand and the outside edge runs wide of first slip for a boundary. First runs in Test cricket for Rahman.
Loopy full ball on off, Shafiul presses forward and defends it nicely to end the over. Well negotiated by the nightwatchman!
Pulls his length back a bit around off, Islam goes on the back foot and blocks it down safely.
Bowls it very full and outside off, Shafiul fails to dig it out and Jonny collects the ball well.
Once again a good stride forward as he defends it close to his front pad.
Gets on the front foot, allows the ball to spin back in and then defends it with gentle hands. Looking a lot at ease against the spinner, Shafiul.
Flighted off spinner on off, Shafiul defends it off his front foot.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump
Lands it on a length and outside off, moving away off the seam, Sabbir withdraws his bat at the last moment. Initially he was looking to play inside the line.
Full toss on off, pushed to covers for a single.
Lands it full and outside off, seaming away, Islam tries playing a cover drive but misses.
Second slip comes into play now.
Back of a length ball on off, shaping away again, Shafiul once again is caught pushing and missing inside the line.
Starts with a good length delivery in the channel outside off, nipping away, Shafiul pushes inside the line and misses.
Ben Stokes to operate from the other end. Last evening it was reversing, let's see how it behaves today. A slip, forward short leg and short mid-wicket in place.
Loopy ball on off, spinning in, Rahman defends it from the inside half of the bat. A very good over by Moeen!
Strides forward and defends it with soft hands to short mid-wicket.
Flighted and outside off, spinning in, Sabbir dances down the track to heave across the line but misses. Luckily for him, the ball hits his pads and doesn't go behind to the keeper.
Flighted ball on off, Sabbir lunges in defense.
Debutant Sabbir Rahman is in next.

OUT! Shakib is stumped! Brain fade from him, just the second ball of the morning and he runs out of patience. Dances down the track for a big shot but the ball lands around off and spins away to beat his bat. It's an easy stumping for Bairstow and Bangladesh have lost a very important wicket. Still trail by 72 runs. Poor, very poor by Shakib, what was he thinking?
Tossed up ball on leg, Shakib gets forward and defends it off the inside half of the bat.
The players and umpires are making their way out to the middle. Shakib has nightwatchman Shafiul for company. It shall be the southpaw on strike. It shall be Moeen Ali to start proceedings on day 3.

Hello and a warm welcome to our coverage of the third day's play. Yesterday was a fairly good day for Bangladesh but the game is still very much in the balance. The first session today will be crucial, especially for England if they are to stay in the match. Shakib will be the key for the hosts while England will want to further exploit the reverse swing. Promises to be another thrilling day's play. The action isn't far away.
.....DAY 3, SESSION 1.....

The deficit for Bangladesh is 72 and although it isn't that far away, given the pitch, England certainly are not out of it yet. They'll hope to nip out the nightwatchman early tomorrow and then build on it. The hosts will know that they are one good partnership away from taking control of the match. The reverse swing could be a key component tomorrow. Do join us at 0930 IST for what should be another pulsating day's play. Till then, it's goodbye from us.

England's bowlers struggled to find their radar in the first two sessions although Ali showed promise with a double strike in his very first over. The spinners largely were inconsistent in their lengths and hence failed to exploit the weary surface that had help for them. They were better in the final session although it were their pacers who managed to create consistent pressure in the final passage of play to stumps. Stokes, Woakes and Broad all got the ball to reverse considerably, thereby putting pressure on Bangladesh's batsmen.

A fairly good day for Bangladesh despite England striking late in all the sessions. Tamim's flawless fifty was the backbone of the hosts' reply with the opener showing tremendous grit and skill on the tricky surface. Rahim and Mahmudullah batted fluently but failed to build on their starts. Their knocks however allowed the home side to put pressure on England's bowlers. Shakib is still there and he's looked in good touch too. It'll be up to him to shepherd the lower order although there is a specialist batsman in Rahman to follow while Mehedi can bat too.
Play and a miss! Stokes serves a full delivery outside off, curving away off the seam, Shafiul pushes inside the line and misses. End of the day's play, stumps!
Final ball of the day...
Spears in a full ball on middle, Islam gets behind the line and pushes it back with a straight bat.
Full and outside off, shaping away again, Shafiul shoulders arms.
Bowls an outswinger but wide outside off, an easy leave for Shafiul.
Umbrella field for the last few deliveries.

Boom! Straight on the helmet. Stokes bangs in a short ball on off, Shafiul tries to duck but the ball hits him on the helmet and flies down to third man. No run taken as it's the nightwatchman's job to protect the main batsman.
Full length ball on off, angling in, Shafiul tries to defend but misses and it goes off his pads to short leg. They appeal just to pressurize the nightwatchman.
Last over of the day coming up. Ben Stokes to continue. A leg gully in place.
Full and angling in, Shakib shuffles across with the flick shot but misses and is hit on the pads. Stifled appeal for an lbw is not entertained. Impact was well outside off.
Second slip comes into place.

Almost rolls onto the stumps! Big movement back into the left-hander from outside off, Shakib tries to play it with a straight bat but misses and is hit on the pads. It ricochets and goes very closely past the off stump.
Broad changes his angle and comes from around the wicket. He slants in a full ball on middle and leg, Shakib keeps it out off the inner half of his bat.
On a length and outside off, Shakib defends it on the off side.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Full in length and around leg, it's defended off the pads to mid-wicket.
Lands it full and outside off, nipping in, Shafiul tries to defend but once again gets an inside edge. End of a superb over, a wicket maiden!

Full and angling into the batsman, Islam defends it nervously off his front foot. It comes off an inside edge and hits him on the pads. The ball is lying near the surface, Shafiul goes down to pick it up but is stopped by Stokes. Hmmm...
Good length ball angling into the batsman, Shafiul fails to defend and is hit on the thigh pad.
Shafiul Islam is the nightwatchman.

OUT! That's a big breakthrough at the fag end of the day! Stokes persists with his line just outside off and gets it to straighten a touch, Rahim has a tame push inside the line without much footwork and gets a faint nick behind. It's dying in front of the keeper, Bairstow leans forward to take the catch but fluffs it a bit. However, he does well to keep it under his gloves. Stokes appeals, the umpire is not sure, walks up to his partner and then takes it upstairs. The replays show that it's cleanly done after the initial hiccup by Jonny. A good knock by the Bangladeshi skipper comes to an end. They trail by 72 runs!
Appeal for a catch. Did it carry? The umpires are not sure and hence refer it upstairs. Soft signal is out.
That's a beauty! Back of a length ball angling into the batsman around off, Rahim feels for it inside the line and gets beaten by the away movement.
Bends his back and digs in a short ball outside off, Rahim watches the line closely, drops his wrists and then leans back to allow it through to the keeper.
Full and angling away from the batsman, Shakib stays back and pushes it with an open-faced bat to point. It seems he has pulled down the shutters on his strokemaking with stumps approaching.
Lands it on a length and around leg, Shakib taps it down off his pads to backward short leg.
Good length on middle, Shakib gets across and tucks it to the leg side.
Good length angled away around off, Shakib jabs at it and gets an inside edge on to the pads.
Pitched up around leg stump, Shakib softly taps it towards mid-wicket.
Good length on middle, worked off the back foot towards mid-wicket.
Fuller on the pads, Rahim is a bit early into the flick. Uppish but doesn't carry to short mid-wicket.
Pitched up outside off, curving away a bit, Rahim reaches out and covers the movement to push it towards the covers.
Good length outside off, well defended from the crease.
Length ball outside off, Rahim rides the extra bounce and taps it to cover-point.
Shorter in length outside off, Shakib jabs it down to third man for a single.
Fuller and tailing in from off, crashes into Shakib's front pad as he misses a flick. Appeal for lbw is turned down. Probably did too much.
Short of a length outside off, Rahim stays back and steers it to point.
Full toss outside off, Rahim jams it to the off side with a slightly open bat face.
Fuller and outside off, Rahim gets forward and pushes it to short mid off.
Slightly shorter in length outside off, dabbed off the back foot to point.
Fuller and tailing in from around off, Rahim gets across and jams it to mid on.
Good length outside off, steered from the crease towards point.
Back of a length outside off, pushed off the back foot towards cover.
Length ball on the pads, worked towards mid-wicket.

This is getting a bit ugly from Shakib. Short of a length outside off, weird pull attempted but he was in no position to connect. It's a good thing to show intent but with stumps around the corner, he'd be better served playing more sensibly.
Fuller outside off, Shakib looks to push at it but gets an inside edge on to the pads.
Shortish outside off, Shakib looks to flat bat it but straight to the man at extra cover. It was hit really hard.
The bowling change nearly worked! Length ball outside off, coming in with the angle. Shakib looks to guide it down to third man but there isn't any room. Gets a thick inside edge on to his pads.
Ben Stokes comes on to bowl.
Length ball on middle, angled in, Shakib gets across and tickles it down to fine leg for a single.
Full and around off, Shakib bunts it straight back to the bowler.
Back of a length outside off, width on offer and Rahim essays a fine cut through backward point for a single. Used the pace well.
Good length tailing in from well outside off, this time Shakib does well to slice it through the big gap between the keeper and the lone wide slip. Third man is in place and so just a single.
A man comes in at wide slip.

FOUR! Edged but no slips in place! Frustrating for Woakes but he has to live with it. Fuller and outside off, straightens after pitching as Shakib flashes at it. Gets a thick edge that goes through the vacant slip cordon to the third man fence.
Oh, that was very close! Length ball just outside off, tailed back in sharply and Shakib is beaten comprehensively on the cut. Signs of reverse swing on display.
Another off break that spins sharply into Rahim with extra bounce. Nicely controlled to short leg.
Floated on middle, Rahim stays back and plays it with the turn to the leg side.
50-run stand between Shakib and Rahim!

Fuller outside off, Shakib digs it out towards mid off. Uncertainty in running as Shakib was ball watching initially. Eventually, the run is taken with ease. A fluent and vital partnership this has been so far.
Fuller on off, turning in, Rahim whips it away powerfully past short leg for a single.
Quicker and a bit short outside off, cut away towards sweeper cover for a single.
Streaky runs! Floats it up on off, Shakib steps out and makes room to play a booming drive but gets a thick outside edge on it. Trickles down towards square third man for a brace.
Length ball well outside off, Shakib cuts it away to deep point for a single.
Fuller on middle and leg, Rahim goes across and clips it down to fine leg for a single.
Good length outside off, defended well from the crease.

NOT OUT! Fuller on middle, Rahim gets into a tangle on the shuffle and is pinned on the front pad. Loud appeal for lbw but Dharmasena turns it down. Testing moment for the umpire considering his form in the match. Cook immediately goes for the review. Must say it looked very close to the naked eye. Nothing on the Snicko and so definitely no bat involved. Hawk Eye shows the impact to be in line but it's clipping leg stump which is not enough for the on-field call to be reversed. England lose a review, Rahim survives. A rare good moment for Dharmasena as far as this game is concerned.
England have taken an lbw review against Rahim. Looked really close to the naked eye.
Fullish outside off, Shakib gets forward and caresses it through the covers for a single.
Slow cutter outside off, too close to cut and Shakib is beaten on the stroke.
Quicker and short outside off, slapped away to sweeper cover for a single.
Top edge but falls safe! Floated around off, Shakib goes for the sweep and gets a top edge on it. Lands in no man's land as it rolls towards fine leg. Root from first slip gives chase. Brace taken.
Flighted outside off, Rahim uses his feet and wrists it down to long on for a single.
Another smart stroke albeit with some risk. Flatter off break around off, premeditated paddle scoop from Rahim and gets it behind square leg for a brace. 200 up for Bangladesh.
Drifting in from off, Rahim stays in the crease and covers the turn to block.

FOUR! Top quality stroke! Flighted outside off, Rahim's footwork has been amazing today and once again he shimmies down the track to play a fluent drive through extra cover. Splits sweeper cover and long off to perfection.
Another slower ball outside off, fuller in length and Shakib pushes it to short cover.
Fuller ball closer to off, Shakib pushes at it and gets a faint inside edge on to the pads.
Slower and fuller outside off, Shakib gets forward and gently pushes it to point.
Fullish on middle, Rahim shuffles across and clips it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Fuller and around off, dug out back to the bowler down the track.
Back of a length outside off, Shakib steers it down to third man for a single.
Time for some pace now. Chris Woakes comes back on for a short burst. A short mid off is in place.
Tossed up outside off, Rahim looks to drive but gets the outside edge. Straight to the fielder at short third man.
On a length and spinning into Rahim who works it to mid-wicket with soft hands.
Tossed up outside off, Rahim presses forward to that one and blocks it out.
Quicker ball on leg stump, Shakib shuffles across and drags it towards backward square leg for a single.
Short and spinning into the pads, Rahim gets across and tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy and spinning from outside off, Rahim camps back and covers the turn to block.

FOUR! Shakib's turn to attack! Floated up on middle, advances down the track to loft it straight down the ground. Gets it well to the right of the mid on fielder and finds the fence with ease. Good positive stroke.
A bit short and outside off, cut away towards point where the fielder fumbles to let it to the deep. A couple taken.
Drifting in on leg, Shakib steps out but doesn't quite reach to the pitch of the ball and decides to block.
Very full and on the pads, Shakib clears his front leg and digs it out to mid on.
Flatter and outside leg, Shakib doesn't connect the flick stroke.
Flighted on leg stump, Rahim tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller around off, sharp turn forces the outside edge. Doesn't carry to the gully fielder.
Fuller outside off, Rahim steps out to that one and gets a bat-pad on it to the off side. Single taken.
FOUR! Brilliant intent from Rahim! Floated well outside off, employs the reverse sweep to that one. Not off the middle but has enough to get it fine towards the third man fence.
Spins in sharply from well outside off, Rahim rides the bounce and turn to somehow block it on to the track.
A bit short and spinning in sharply from around off, Rahim stays back and makes a bit of room to play the late cut. Gets it to square third man for a brace.
Tossed up well outside off, Rahim reaches out to get to the pitch of the ball and blocks.
Moeen Ali comes back on for another spell. Crucial last hour coming up, especially for England.
Drinks break.
Gets forward and drives it past the bowler to mid off.
Lunges to a full ball and defends it back.
Pushed through quicker outside off,  short and spinning away, Shakib tries to cut but misses.
Fires a fuller one on leg, flicked on the leg side to mid-wicket.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Tossed up ball on middle and off, defended off the pads to the leg side.
Flighted on middle, Shakib goes back and defends it off his pads to the leg side.
Tossed up on off, defended off the front foot.
Short and wide outside off, Shakib reaches out and cuts it straight to point.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Too full in length outside off, Shakib digs it out to mid on.
Full flighted on off, Rahim helps it down through mid on for a single.
FOUR! Shot! Batty bowls it quicker through the air and lands it fuller on off, Shakib leans forward and spanks it through covers for a boundary.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. No run.
Advances down the track and drives it to mid off for a quick single. The fielder misses his shy at the striker's end, no one backing it up and they cross for an overthrow as well.
Presses forward and pushes a full ball to mid off.
Around off, a touch short, Shakib defends it off his back foot.
Loopy full ball on middle, Shakib gets forward and defends it back to the bowler.
Floated and on middle, drifting in, Rahim gets forward and defends it on the leg side. A decent first over by Root!
Shortish on off, cut straight to point.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! Wonderful footwork to dance down to the pitch of the ball. Rahim then shows a lovely flow of his bat as he drives it through mid off for a boundary.
Spinning down, Rahim helps it to backward square leg.
Nicely tossed up ball around leg, Rahim flicks it on the leg side where the short mid-wicket fielder dives to stop the ball.
Joe Root to have a go now.
Short on middle, pulled powerfully to deep mid-wicket where Rashid made a tumbling stop. Only a run taken.

NOT OUT! Flatter and a touch shorter outside off, Shakib punches it to covers and scampers across for a quick single. The throw comes flat to the keeper who takes the bails off as Rahim dives in. They appeal, it's referred upstairs and the replays show that Bairstow was a shade slow in taking the bails off. Shakib is off the mark!
Appeal for a run out. Referred upstairs...
Shakib Al Hasan arrives.

OUT! Against the run of play, England get the prized wicket of Tamim Iqbal! Batty bowls it quicker through the air and around off, Iqbal goes back to cut it through the line but it's too close to his body. He ends up getting a faint edge to the keeper who grabs a sharp catch. They appeal and almost instantaneously the finger goes up. Tamim has a chat with his skipper regarding the DRS before heading back to the pavilion. End of a fine knock! Bangladesh trail by 130 runs.
Tossed up and around off, Tamim is on the back foot in defense.
Short and wide outside off, cut away with the spin through point for a couple of runs.
Tossed up ball around leg, Rahim quietly nudges it wide of leg slip for a single.
Tossed up ball on off, spinning down, Iqbal allows it through.

Uppish but safe! Loopy leg spinner on leg, Rahim goes for the sweep but fails to keep it down. The ball goes aerial and just wide of Duckett at backward square leg. He chases it down and they take three runs.
Slow leg spinner, on the shorter side, Rahim turns it through mid-wicket and returns for the second run.
Spinning down the leg side, Tamim helps it on its way through square leg for a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Sharp spin into the batsman from outside off, Tamim tries to flick but it takes an inside edge and goes on one bounce to leg slip.
Flighted and on off, defended off the front foot by Rahim.
Joe Root is warming up...
Prods forward to a full ball and drives it through mid off for a single.
Spinning away from the batsman, Tamim steers it with the turn to point.
Landing outside leg, Iqbal offers no shot and takes it on his pads.
Flighted and on off, Tamim stays back and defends it to mid on.
Poor ball, short and on middle, Tamim eases himself on the back foot and hits it firmly past the left side of the mid on fielder. Good enough for a couple of runs.
Gareth Batty to have another go.
Loopy and around off, Mushfiqur defends it with the spin to the off side.
Tossed up ball outside off, left alone.
Wayward delivery, full and way down the leg side, Rahim kneels and sweeps it through backward square leg for a couple of runs. Nice roll of the wrists! 150 up for Bangladesh!
This one is too full and off, not allowing the ball to turn much, Rahim defends it back to the bowler.
Turning square. Landing around leg and curling away, Rahim plays inside the line and misses.
Flighted and very full outside off, Tamim drives it wide of mid off for a single.
This one is short and wide as well, Tamim goes back and punches it to sweeper cover for a run.
Bowls it a touch short and around off, Tamim tries to cut but it's too close to his body and he misses.
Moeen Ali switches to over the wicket.
Flighted and outside off, spinning away, Tamim tries to run it down but finds backward point.
Full toss on off, Tamim forces it down to long on for a single.
Ali is on the shorter side outside off, Tamim plays a cracking cut shot but it goes straight to short point.
Long hop on off, spinning in, Rahim goes deep inside the crease and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Big spin into the batsman from the rough outside off, Tamim shoulders arms and it goes off his hip to leg gully. The fielder runs across to his right to catch the ball but no appealing.
A full toss on middle, Tamim knocks it down the ground for a couple of runs.
Spinning back into the batsman from a fuller length outside off, Iqbal defends it off his front foot.
Loopy and outside off, Tamim tries to reverse sweep off the rough but fails to connect. Needless from Iqbal!
Flighted and outside off, Tamim presses forward in defense.
Full and around middle, spinning down, Tamim allows it through and it's a good take by Jonny.
Full flighted ball on off, Rahim pushes it off his front foot to mid off.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Flighted on middle, defended with the spin to short leg.
Quicker full ball on middle, Rahim tries to go back and defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball almost rolls onto the stumps.
Allows the ball to spin back in and Rahim nudges it to leg gully.
Short in length and on off, Tamim goes back and punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! Loose, very loose. A friendly full toss on middle, Rahim goes down on one knee and smashes it through mid-wicket for a cracking boundary.
Tossed up ball on middle, turning down, Iqbal goes back and eases it to deep backward square leg for a single.
FOUR! Fine, fine shot! Rashid once again pitches it short outside off and gets it to turn back in, Tamim rocks back and punches it wide of mid off for a boundary.
Landing outside off and getting it to spin back in, Tamim goes back in defense.
Fuller and on leg, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Hangs on the back foot to a shortish ball and pushes it off his pads to short mid-wicket.
Full floated on off, Rahim stretches forward and defends it right under his watchful eyes.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
A touch short on middle, spinning down, Rahim goes back to pull, a bit half-heartedly and it goes off the bottom edge to leg gully, on one bounce.
Quicker and a touch shorter on off, Iqbal punches it square of the wicket on the off side, the fielder is quite deep and they steal a single.
Flighted and outside off, extra lift, Tamim lets it through to the keeper.
Flighted on off, spinning away, Rahim stays back and keeps it out on the off side.
Attempted googly but on the shorter side outside off, Tamim hangs back and punches it through covers for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Spinning down the leg side, eased away to fine leg for a couple of runs.
Goes back to a short ball and punches it to the bowler.
Loopy ball around off, spinning down, Tamim gloves his attempted flick shot and it runs wide of leg gully. Good enough for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Excellent footwork! Rahim gives the charge on this occasion, it's full and around off and he goes with the spin to loft it down the ground for a boundary.
FOUR! Against the spin but well timed and placed! Floated ball outside off, too full in length, Rahim drives it crisply through covers for a boundary. Gets off the mark!
Flighted and on off, spinning in, Rahim tries to defend it off his front foot but it takes the inside half of the bat and goes on one bounce to leg gully.
Once again an off spinner is defended from the crease to the leg side.
Spinning back into the batsman from outside off, Rahim goes deep inside the crease and keeps it out safely.
Flatter and quicker on middle, shorter in length too, Tamim goes back and works it in front of the square leg for a single.
That's the line! Rashid lands his leg spinner on leg and gets it to curve away sharply, Rahim tries to defend but it spins away big to beat the outside edge. Terrific over, a wicket maiden!
Once again a big leg spinner outside off, but it's too wide to trouble the batsman.
Gives this one extra rev and lands it around off, Rahim has a good look at it, reads the spin quite well and leaves it alone. That almost turned square.
Slow loopy leg spinner on off, Rahim gets on the front foot in defense.
We're back and so are the players. 30.4 overs of play still remaining in the day. Skipper Mushfiqur Rahim has joined Tamim Iqbal in the middle. Adil Rashid to complete his over.
DAY 2, SESSION 3...

England's bowlers did get turn but were too wayward in their lines. Rashid and Ali got purchase while Batty was too erratic to create any pressure. Whenever they managed to hit the right spots, they did cause trouble. However, credit must be given to both Tamim and Mahmudullah for countering the turn well on this tricky surface. Mahmudullah's dismissal has brought England back but the hosts will still feel confident. Join us in a while for the last session.

This session - 29.3 overs, 90 runs, 1 wicket. Almost the perfect session for Bangladesh although England will take solace from that strike, once again at the stroke of a break. Tamim and Mahmudullah batted with great confidence although the latter was a bit lax at times. They countered spin really well and seemed set to create the first wicketless session of the match before Mahmudullah's laziness cost him.

OUT! RASHID STRIKES! Once again a wicket to end the session. Lovely leg break outside off, fizzes away and Mahmudullah has a lazy poke at it. Unwanted shot really and the edge goes straight to Root who gobbles it up at slip. Ends a very valuable 90-run stand. THAT SHALL BE TEA ON DAY 2.
Tossed up leg break outside off, defended well off the front foot.

NOT OUT! DRS continues to derail Dharmasena. Floated off break outside off, Tamim pushes at it and the ball bobbles to first slip where Root takes it brilliantly one-handed to his right. Appeal for a catch and Dharmasena raises his finger as an afterthought. Tamim isn't amused and goes for the review immediately. Replays confirm that it had gone off the elbow. Snickometer confirms it and so the on-field call is overturned. Tamim survives.
Tamim has been given out at slip. He's gone for the review straightaway.
Nicely tossed up outside off, Tamim gets well forward and blocks it out.
Flighted outside off, Mahmudullah lunges into it and nudges it to cover-point for a brisk single. Smart batting to rotate the strike.
Drops it short outside off, Tamim sits back and crunches it to deep cover for a single.
Flighted on off, stepped out to that one and drives it down to long on for a single.
Fuller outside off, swept away to the leg side.
Two Leg byes! The leg break spins in sharply and Tamim misses the flick. The ball goes off the pads down the leg side to the deep. A couple of leg byes added.
Drifting in from outside off, defended well off the back foot.
That kept very low! Well done by Mahmudullah as he managed to block the leg break off the back foot to the leg side. Adjusted well at the last moment. Single taken.
Fuller outside off, spinning in, Tamim's drive goes awry and he gets a thick inside edge towards backward square leg. Single taken.
Flatter outside off, punched off the back foot to the off side.
Full toss on middle, thumped down the ground to long on for a single.
Adil Rashid is brought back into the attack.
Close call! Fuller on leg, inside out drive from Tamim and it's in the air for a while. Falls safely before the point fielder.
Drifting away outside off, sharp turn and the ball beats the outside edge.
Fuller outside off, blocked well off the front foot.
19th Test fifty for Tamim Iqbal!

FOUR! Well played Tamim! Spinning away but too short to trouble Iqbal. He sits back and punches it sweetly through the covers to find the fence. This has been a subdued and responsible knock from him so far. He's maturing into a fine Test player.
Short and spinning away, pushed off the back foot towards cover.
Tossed up off break outside off, spinning away slowly as Tamim leaves it alone.

Nimble footwork! Floats it up on leg, Mahmudullah puts the dancing shoes on and chips it uppishly in the gap at mid-wicket. Woakes from long on runs across to his right to make a tumbling stop. Just about manages to pull the ball back into play. They check it upstairs and it seems a clean fielding effort. Brace added to the total.
Full toss on leg stump, Mahmudullah misses out and clips it straight to mid-wicket. Batty got away with one there.
Fuller outside off, pushed gently to the covers for a single.
Flatter outside off, Tamim punches it off the back foot to cover.
Flatter outside off, Tamim blocks it well from the crease.

Flighted outside off, Mahmudullah pushes it with soft hands towards the gully region. Tamim wanted the single and eggs his partner on for the run. Mahmudullah was slow to take off but made his ground eventually.
Quicker ball on the the pads, very full and Tamim works it through wide mid on for a brace.
Nicely flighted outside off, Tamim gets forward and pushes it to short cover.
Drifting in from outside off, turns away as Tamim lets it pass.
Quicker ball spinning into the pads, Mahmudullah works it round the corner for a run.
Quicker ball outside off, jabbed off the back foot towards point.
Good ball to start! The off break spins in a mile from outside off, shortish and Mahmudullah camps back to play at it. Gets a bottom edge on to the pitch.
Moeen Ali comes back on for another spell. His first over saw two wickets. Can he do it with the first over of his new spell too? England badly need it. He's bowling from a different end though.
Tamim gives the charge and Batty responds by darting it very full on leg stump. Dug out towards short cover.
Very full on middle, Tamim squeezes it out towards short cover.
Short and spinning away outside off, Tamim steers it with the turn but straight to backward point.
Tossed up on middle, Mahmudullah reaches out to it and whips it through mid-wicket for a run. Brings up the 100 for Bangladesh.
Flighted on off, Mahmudullah steps out and clips it towards short leg.
Fuller around leg, Mahmudullah reverse sweeps it to the off side.
Fuller outside off, defended well off the front foot.

Mix up but safe in the end. Fuller on leg stump, Tamim works it towards backward square leg and sets off for the single. He then decides to go back but Mahmudullah didn't halt initially. Tamim sends back his partner in time and eventually no harm done. Second time this has happened in the last 30 minutes.
Fuller on middle, Tamim gets forward and works it to short mid-wicket.

And again! Good length outside off, slanting in a touch and Mahmudullah once again looks to push without any footwork. Another inside edge that goes just past leg stump towards deep backward square leg. Single taken.
Nearly chopped on! Length ball angling in from outside off, Mahmudullah pokes at it and gets a thick inside edge on to the pads.
Fuller and veering in around off, well defended off the front foot.
Fuller on middle and off, worked towards mid-wicket for an easy single.
Flighted on off, fuller in length and Mahmudullah digs it to short mid-wicket.
Drifting in from around off, Mahmudullah works it with the spin towards backward square leg.
Very full on leg stump, Tamim leans across and pushes it to short mid-wicket for a quick single.
Quicker ball on leg stump, Tamim looks to push at it but is pinned on the front pad.
Floated on middle, Mahmudullah works it with the turn towards backward square leg. Single added.
Fuller ball on leg stump, Tamim moves across and jams it to short mid-wicket.
A cutter on middle and off, Tamim gets across to that one and taps it to short mid-wicket.
Fuller outside off, nicely blocked off the front foot to cover.
Back of a length on leg stump, Tamim misses the flick and is hit on the thigh pad.
Fuller on middle, Tamim pushes at it and gets a thick inside edge on to the pads.
Positive stroke! Fuller ball outside off, Mahmudullah leans into it and times the drive nicely past mid off. Won't make the fence but the batsmen will take take three.

Nervy moment! Flatter and short outside off, Tamim forces it off the back foot to cover and sets off for a non-existent run. Rightfully, Mahmudullah sends him back and the southpaw just gets back in time.
Slider outside off, reaches out to that one and defends it out.
Quicker ball outside off, blocked out well from the crease.
Drifting in fuller on off, Tamim defends with his bat before his front pad.
Floats it up on middle, worked away towards mid-wicket deftly.
Tossed up outside off, Tamim digs it out towards short mid off.
Fuller and on off, gets across and jams it to short mid on.
Fuller ball on middle, gets across and taps it to short mid-wicket.
FOUR! Languid stroke! Back of a length outside off, Mahmudullah stands tall and punches it sweetly through backward point to find the fence. Class oozing in that shot.
Fuller this time and another solid front foot press from Mahmudullah.
Good length outside off, Mahmudullah reaches out and blocks it out.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot to the off side.
Stuart Broad comes back on for another spell.
Tossed up outside off, Mahmudullah continues to use his feet well and clips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter outside off, hangs back and punches it down to long off for a single.
Spinning away but too short as Tamim jabs it off the back foot to cover.
Flighted outside off, defended well off the front foot.
Flatter outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Flighted outside off, Mahmudullah uses his feet and works it with the turn to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Time for the players to have a drink. Bangladesh's hour after lunch with both players looking assured. They've played spin really well with good intent. England need a breakthrough sooner than later.
Fullish outside off, Tamim presses forward and blocks it.
Superb yorker and equally well responded by Tamim as he digs it out just in time.
Good length outside off, Tamim gets behind the line nicely and defends.
Length ball outside off, Tamim defends it well from the crease.
Full and outside off, blocked well off the front foot to the off side.
Good length on middle, Mahmudullah tucks it behind square leg for a single.
Fuller on middle and leg, Tamim clips it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Fuller outside off, Tamim leans into it and blocks it out.
Flatter outside off, pushed off the back foot to point.
Quicker ball around off, Tamim gets back to that one and blocks it firmly.
Very full outside off, Tamim jams it towards short cover.
Flighted off break well outside off, spinning away, Tamim lets it pass.
Gareth Batty is back on.
Fullish and on the pads, Iqbal nudges it to long leg for a single.
False shot! Stokes bowls a cutter wide outside off, Tamim has a wild chase and misses.
Steams in and bowls a sharp short ball outside off, Tamim goes on his toes and taps it down on the off side.
Oohhh...that missed the outside edge and off stump by a whisker. An off cutter around off, Tamim tries to defend but misses.
50-run stand between Tamim and Mahmudullah.

FOUR! Back to back boundaries! Not in full control this time though. Stokes offers width outside off, Tamim tries to cut it through the line but it catches the bottom half of the bat and runs down to third man for a boundary.
FOUR! Well placed and timed! Stokes bowls it full and around middle, angling in, 142.9 kph, Tamim picks it off his pads and flicks it sweetly past the mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.
Loopy ball on middle, Tamim plays a nice inside-out off drive for a single.
A touch flatter and on off, Tamim defends it off his back foot.
Spinning down, Mahmudullah goes back and helps it to square leg for one.
Walks down the track and flicks it with the spin to mid-wicket.
Tossed up ball on off, it's played back to the bowler off the front foot.
Flighted ball landing outside off, spinning in, Mahmudullah gets forward and across to sweep but misses. He is hit on the pads but the impact is outside off.
Full and on off, driven off the front foot to covers.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Fuller on off, defended off the front foot to the off side.

Nearly an outside edge! Stokes switches to over the wicket for the right-hander and bowls a full ball just outside off. It holds its line after pitching and Mahmudullah is caught pushing and missing inside the line.
Delivers it very full and around middle, Tamim gets forward and flicks it through square leg for a run.
Spears in a fuller length ball on off, Tamim gets forward in defense.
Ben Stokes to operate from around the wicket.
Tossed up ball on off, spinning in, Mahmudullah looks to defend off the front foot but it takes an inside edge which goes wide of short leg.
Gets on the front foot and pushes it to wide mid off for a single.
Tamim has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Great delivery, a yorker on the leg stump line, Tamim brings down his bat just in time to dig it out.

Nearly a stunner by Rashid off an awful delivery. Short and outside off, Tamim goes back and cuts it in the air. Rashid dives to his left at point but fails to hold on to the catch. They cross for a couple.
Tossed up ball on off, Iqbal draws forward in defense.

FOUR! Well controlled shot! Stokes serves it on a length outside off, straightening a bit, Mahmudullah gets forward and pushes at it with a gentle bottom hand. It comes off the outside edge and screams through gully for a boundary.
Fullish and on off, Mahmudullah pushes it through the line. It goes on one bounce over short cover and the striker looks for a run. He is sent back by Tamim as the mid off fielder has it covered.
Play and a miss! A very average shot attempted by Mahmudullah. Throws his bat at a wide delivery outside off and gets beaten. He needs to be patient.
Full and angling in a round off, Mahmudullah defends it off his front foot.
Lovely delivery, full and outside off, holding its line, Mahmudullah pushes at it without any footwork and misses.
On a length outside off, Mahmudullah pushes it off his front foot to point.

Ben Stokes is introduced into the attack. A mini-conference going on at the moment, involving the bowler, Stuart Broad and skipper Alastair Cook. One slip in place and a couple of close-in fielders at covers and mid-wicket.
Presses forward to a full ball and pushes it gently in the gap at covers for one.
Tamim has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flighted ball on off, pushed down to mid on.
Pushes it quicker through the air and lands it full on off, Tamim defends it by taking his bat and pad together.
Fullish on off, Tamim drives it through with good wristwork but finds covers.
Floated one, full and around middle, spinning away a bit, Tamim brings his bat in front of pads in defense.
Once again the length is a bit short on middle, Mahmudullah gets back and punches it straight to short mid-wicket.
Better line and length, it's full around middle and leg, Mahmudullah gets forward and defends it with soft hands.
Shortish and on off, Tamim gets back and slaps it to sweeper cover for one.
Flicks it with the spin on the leg side but finds short mid-wicket.
Tossed up ball on off, spinning in, Tamim fails to put bat on ball and is rapped on the pads. They appeal but it's missing leg.
Leg slip moves to extra cover.
FOUR! Shot! Flighted full ball wide outside off, Tamim reaches out for it and smashes it through extra cover for a crunching boundary.
Floated ball on middle, Tamim gets forward and works it in the gap at wide mid on for a single.
FOUR! This time the bad delivery has been put away! Moeen is on the shorter side outside off, Tamim hangs back and whacks it through covers for a boundary.
A full toss on middle, Tamim tries to play across the line but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Tossed up ball on off, Tamim goes on the back foot in defense.
Quicker around middle, Mahmudullah goes back and eases it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted ball on off, a bit on the shorter side as it spins away, Iqbal goes on the back foot and plays it late with the turn. He places it wide of point and collects a single.
Flighted and on off, spinning away, Mahmudullah remains on the back foot and defends it with the spin to the off side.
Quicker one around the leg stump line, Mahmudullah fails to get it away and is hit on the pads.
Loopy ball around leg, spinning towards off, Mahmudullah goes back and defends it down.
Shortish and on off, Tamim goes deep inside the crease and punches it to sweeper cover for a single. 50 up for Bangladesh!
A juicy half-volley outside off, Mahmudullah drills it through covers for a single.
FOUR! Another freebie by Rashid, bowls a friendly full toss on middle, Mahmudullah reaches out for it with a big stride and whips it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Presses forward to a full ball and pushes it straight to covers.
Moeen gets away after bowling a long hop. Around off and Tamim cuts it straight to cover-point.
Quicker this time, fuller on off and turning away, Tamim lunges in defense.
Beaten! Spin and bounce around off, Tamim tries to defend it off his front foot but is beaten. Unplayable!
Walks down to the pitch of the ball and eases it to widish mid on for a single.
Full around off, spinning in sharply, Mahmudullah defends it off his pads to short leg.
A touch short and around off, spinning in, Tamim gets back and works it straight to short mid-wicket.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Spinning down the leg side, Tamim leaves it and Bairstow does well to collect it as it stayed a bit low.
Tossed up ball on middle and leg, spinning down, Iqbal fails to flick and it goes off his pads and beats leg gully for a couple of leg byes.
FOUR! Poor delivery and put away! Rashid bowls with extra flight but fails to land it. Tamim greets the full toss gleefully and lofts it over covers for a boundary.
Loopy and fuller on off, Tamim lunges in defense.

Flatter through the air, full and on middle, spinning away a shade, Tamim goes forward to defend and gets it off the inside half of the bat. It runs down to fine leg and they collect three runs. Believe me, had there been no inside edge, Iqbal would have been a plumb lbw candidate.
Full flighted ball on middle, Tamim defends it off his front foot.
Gets back inside the crease and pushes it to covers.
Wow, extra bounce around off along with big spin, Tamim allows it through and Bairstow does well to collect it.
Tossed up ball on middle, knocked down to long on for a single.
Uppish but safe! Loopy ball on middle, spinning down, Mahmudullah flicks it off his pads, a bit aerial but wide of short leg. Straight to backward square leg.
Quicker and fuller on leg, worked to square leg to end the over.
Big turn on this occasion, landing outside off and spinning down, Tamim tries flicking but misses. It goes off his thigh pad to leg slip.
Fullish on off, Tamim pushes it by using his wrists to short mid-wicket.
Rashid drags his length short and lands it around off, Tamim goes back and punches it to mid off.
Loopy full ball on off, spinning in, Tamim gets forward and across to help it towards short leg.
Flighted ball and it's very full outside off, Mahmudullah drives it through covers for a single.
Fullish on off, Tamim drives it off his front foot but finds covers.
Spin and bounce around off, Tamim gets back and pushes it a bit aerially towards the cover region.
Tossed up and outside off, Mahmudullah works it around towards mid-wicket for a single.
Gets on the front foot to a full ball and defends it to the off side.
Fine fielding by Broad! Tossed up ball on off, Mahmudullah plays a full-blooded sweep shot, it's timed nicely but Broad at backward square leg dives to his right to save a certain boundary.
Bowls it very full and around leg, Tamim eases it wide of mid on, it's to the left side of the fielder and by the time he stops it, they cross for a single.
Goes flatter and shorter on off, spinning away, Mahmudullah hangs back to push it through the line but gets it off the inside half of the bat.
Flighted one on middle, fuller in length, Mahmudullah draws forward in defense.
Floated full ball on off, Tamim lunges and pushes it softly towards point for a quick single.
A touch flatter on off, spinning in a bit, Tamim goes back in defense.
Tossed up ball on middle, too full in length, Iqbal taps it down in front of short leg.
Lovely delivery, a flighted one outside off, going straight on, Tamim plays for the spin but is beaten.
Adil Rashid to continue from the other end.
Full flighted ball on off, Mahmudullah walks forward and pushes it to mid on. End of a very successful over by Ali.

Welcome back for the post-lunch session. It seems like another riveting couple of hours are in store for us. The players and umpires are out there in the middle. Mahmudullah is the new man in and he'll be on strike. Ali to resume his over.
.....DAY 2, SESSION 2.....

The day started well for Bangladesh though as they didn't waste too much time to finish off the England innings. The tourists added 35 runs to their overnight score before being bowled out. However, 293 is a very competitive score and as Ali's solitary over has shown, this looks a very tough track to bat, especially with the new ball if it is spinning away from the batsman. Join us in a while as another engrossing session is coming up shortly.

What a finish to the session! The two late strikes have meant that England will go to lunch with momentum on their side. Bangladesh's openers started solidly and looked set to go to the break unbeaten but Ali had other ideas. Firstly he dislodged Kayes with a ripper and then two balls later removed Mominul with another cracking off break to trigger tension in the hosts' dressing room.

OUT! ALI HAS ANOTHER! This is top class spin bowling from Ali! The off break around off, sharp turn once again and this time Mominul isn't lucky enough. Gets the outside edge that brushes Bairstow's gloves and bobbles to Stokes at gully who pouches it with ease. THAT SHALL BE LUNCH ON DAY 2.
Beaten! The pitch is playing tricks, as it has been with the new ball in this game. Mominul has no clue to this off break from Ali and is beaten all ends up.
Fuller on off, Mominul presses forward and blocks it out.
Mominul Haque comes out to bat.

OUT! GOT HIM! Ali has started with a bang! Lovely drift into the batsman and Kayes has to play at it. The ball spins away ever so slightly to beat the edge and disturbs the timber. Moeen draws first blood for England and already signs that he could be a big threat on this surface for Bangladesh.
Beaten! Ali starts with a ripper. The off break rips and turns away sharply to beat the outside edge.
Moeen Ali comes on to bowl. He'll enjoy this, two left-handers at the crease and quite a few to follow as well.
Tossed up outside leg, Kayes goes for the reverse sweep through point for a single.
Loopy on leg stump, turns in to rap Kayes on the pads. Going well down the leg side.
Drifting in from around off, blocked well from the crease.

FOUR! Fab shot! Good intent from Kayes! Sees the flighted ball on middle and sweeps it away well in front of square on the leg side to the fence. This will be a challenge for Rashid with two left-handers at the crease.

Well bowled! Loopy leg break on off, Rashid gets his line right and instant response off the deck. The ball spins sharply to get a bat pad. Luckily for Kayes, it lands well before the short leg fielder.
Shorter and turning into the pads, Tamim clips it round the corner for a single.
Time for some leg spin then as Adil Rashid comes on to bowl.
Tossed up outside off, Kayes drives but straight to the fielder at cover.

That was a half-chance of sorts! Floated outside off, Kayes looks to drive but cannot quite keep the shot down. Goes well to the right of Batty who isn't that quick to react. The ball goes to the mid off fielder.
Flatter on middle, Kayes gets across and works it to mid-wicket.
Finds the edge! The off break turns sharply to force the outside edge but there isn't a gully in place. The ball goes well past first slip. Brace taken.
Fullish outside off, blocked well off the front foot.
Fuller on off, Kayes gets across to that one and sweeps it to the leg side. Looked a bit awkward while playing the stroke.
Back of a length outside off, fended off the back foot to the off side.
Back of a length outside off, steered off the back foot towards point for a single.
Back of a length on middle, ducks under it.
Good length on middle, Tamim gets across and tucks it behind square leg for a run.
Fuller around off, Tamim presses forward and blocks it out.
Back of a length wider outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Fuller outside off, blocked firmly off the front foot.
Slightly shorter outside off, blocked off the back foot towards silly point.
FOUR! Fluent shot! Tossed up outside off, inviting the drive and Kayes obliges with a booming shot through the covers. A bit aerial but he found the gap to perfection to get the boundary.
Drifting in on the pads, Imrul leans across and taps it towards mid-wicket.
Kayes pulls out of the delivery. Seems like something's gone into his eyes. Happens in this heat. The 12th man comes out with water and he washes his eyes. Should be alright.
Quicker ball outside off, blocked off the back foot.
Quicker and a bit short, tucked off the back foot towards mid-wicket for a single.
Pitched up outside off, Kayes presses forward and blocks it.
Fuller and outside off, Kayes reaches out and eases it towards point.
Length ball angling across Kayes. The line is too wide to make him play.
Wide! Dug in short on middle and leg, Kayes ducks under it. Wide signalled for height.
Dug in short outside off, extra bounce as Kayes continues to leave.
Length ball angled away outside off, another leave from Kayes.
Good length outside off, Imrul isn't interested to play at it.
Fuller on middle and leg, Kayes sweeps it through square leg for a run.
Flatter on leg stump, pins Kayes on the pads. Needless appeal for lbw as that was clearly missing leg.
Fuller on middle and off, Kayes bunts it towards mid on.
Ballance comes in at silly point.
Very full on middle, dug out back to the bowler.
Flighted outside off, pushed off the front foot towards cover.
Flighted fuller on leg stump, nudged towards mid-wicket with soft hands.
Length ball angled away from the batsman. Far too wide outside off to bother Tamim.
Fuller ball outside off, nicely blocked off the front foot towards cover.
Good length outside off, Tamim blocks it with his exaggerated stride.
Good length outside off, steered towards the point region.
Good length on middle, extra bounce and Tamim defends awkwardly with the bottom hand coming off the blade.
Back of a length just outside off, good bounce and carry for Woakes to start with. Left alone by Tamim.
Chris Woakes comes on to bowl.
Quicker ball outside off, defended well off the back foot.
Floats it up outside off, Kayes reaches out and defends it well.
Flatter outside off, punched off the back foot to the off side.
Fuller outside off, no shot offered to that one.
Flatter outside off, Tamim looks to force it on the off side but gets a bottom edge.
Floats it outside off, easy leave for Tamim.
Back of a length outside off, Kayes lets it pass.
Dug in short on leg stump, left alone to the keeper.
Good length on leg stump, extra bounce as the ball raps Kayes on his thighs.
That's a good leave! Good length angled away from closer to off, Kayes shuffles across and lifts his bat to let it pass. Good judgement.
Dug in short around leg stump, once again the line means that Kayes can duck comfortably.
Length ball on middle, Tamim reaches out and nudges it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and shorter in length, Kayes hangs back to block it firmly.
Fuller around off, Kayes presses forward to that one and smothers it to the ground.
Gets the edge this time! Lovely from Batty. Tossed up nicely around off, plenty of revs on the ball as Kayes pushes at it. The outside edge flies between slip and gully to the deep. Brace added.
That's taken off! Batty gives this one a lot of air and drifts it into the batsman. Sharp turn and bounce as the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
Slider outside off, pushed off the back foot towards the covers.
Loopy outside off, Kayes goes back for the cut but is beaten.
Fuller outside off, blocked well off the front foot.
Fuller around off, Tamim gets forward and blocks it towards mid-wicket.
Shortish around off, Tamim shuffles across and blocks it out off the back foot.
Goes for a short ball but gets the line horribly wrong, fires it down the leg side and that's an easy leave for Tamim.
Good length angled in from around off, Kayes stays back and tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller and just around off, Kayes leans forward and pats it to the covers.
Fuller outside off, defended well off the front foot.
Floats it up outside off, left alone to the keeper.
Quicker ball outside off, a bit shorter in length and Tamim defends off the back foot.
Edge but safe! Floats it up around off, drifting in but straightens after pitching. Kayes pushes at it with soft hands and the outside edge flies well past first slip to the deep. A single taken.
Shortish and outside off, Imrul punches it off his back foot to covers for a single.
FOUR! Not a good ball to bowl first up! Short and wide outside off, Kayes latches onto it and slaps it through point for a cracking boundary.

Gareth Batty is introduced into the attack from the other end. He's playing for England after a long gap of 11 years. Would like to make this comeback a memorable one for him. He will have the assistance of the pitch to do so. Let's see how he fares...
Fuller just outside off, Tamim leans into it and defends it well.
Broad goes too straight and drifts on to the pads. Tamim tucks it through backward square leg for a brace.
Another good length ball outside off, once again Tamim makes an unusual leave by getting way inside the line.
That's a good ball! Good length angled in from outside off, keeps coming in with the angle. Tamim plays well inside the line of it.
Pitched up outside off, just a bit wide to make Tamim play.
Fuller outside off, Tamim gets a big stride in and blocks it out to cover.
